name: Dataverse teams
short_description: Teams in Dataverse that hold security roles or own rows: owner teams, access teams for record-level collaboration, and Microsoft Entra group teams whose membership follows a directory group.

evidence.quote: owner teams and access teams, two different tools. Dataverse has more than one kind of team
Teams make permission management even easier.
Teams let groups of people own records together. Two main types matter here, owning teams and access teams.
